map.表示当前设备配置无法在交期内完成订单，缺口 = 订单量 − 理论月产能。需新增设: It means the current equipment setup cannot complete the order within the delivery deadline, with a gap = order volume - theoretical monthly capacity. You need extra machines (ceil(gap / capacity per machine) units) or outsourcing, and should inspect the bottleneck process first.
map.输入设备数量、工时、班次与设备效率，评估产线产能利用率并规划设备、工时与班次安排: Enter the number of machines, labour hours, shifts and machine efficiency to assess line capacity utilisation and plan equipment, hours and shifts, for manufacturing capacity planning and scheduling.
map.：某机加工车间 5 台 CNC、单台日产能 200 件、2 班/日、月工作 22: : a machining workshop with 5 CNC machines, 200 parts per machine per day, 2 shifts a day and 22 working days a month has a monthly order of 20,000 parts. Theoretical monthly capacity = 5*200*22*2 = 44,000 parts; capacity utilisation = 20000/44000 ≈ 45.5% (spare). The minimum machines needed for that order is ceil(20000/(200*22*2)) = 3. Conclusion: the current 5 machines can take the order comfortably, or 2 spare machines could be redirected to other orders.
map.本工具纯前端运行，输入内容不上传服务器；结果为按上述口径得到的理论估算值。实际应: This tool runs entirely in the browser and does not upload inputs. Results are theoretical estimates using the method above. Actual use depends on equipment parameters, measurement conditions and local standards; refer to equipment nameplates, test reports and current standards, and consult professionals for major decisions.
map.接到突发大单时，快速核算当前设备配置能否在交期内达成，并定位需要优先扩容的瓶颈工: When a large rush order arrives, quickly check whether the current equipment can meet the due date and identify the process to expand first; with zero orders, view idle capacity, and the multi-process table sorts monthly capacity ascending to find the bottleneck.
map.：某机加工车间 5 台 CNC、单台班产能 200 件、2 班/日、月工作 22: : A machining shop has 5 CNCs, 200 pieces per machine-shift, 2 shifts/day, 22 working days/month and a 20,000-piece monthly order. Theoretical monthly capacity = 5×200×2×22 = 44,000 pieces; utilization = 20,000÷44,000 ≈ 45.5% (slack); the minimum machines needed = ⌈20,000÷(200×2×22)⌉ = 3. Conclusion: the 5-machine configuration can take the order comfortably, or 2 machines can be freed for other work. To split the shop into processes, enter rows “process, machines, output per machine-shift, shifts per day” in the multi-process table; the tool sorts monthly capacity ascending and the smallest is the bottleneck. With demand 0 it still shows theoretical capacity and full idleness, without an error or a fabricated gap.
map.单工序模式能直接说“本工序即瓶颈”吗？: Can single-process mode say “this process is the bottleneck”?
map.不能。单工序只能做产能缺口评估；瓶颈须比较整条线的各工序月产能。填写多工序表后，: No. Single-process mode only assesses the capacity gap; a bottleneck requires comparing monthly capacity across the line. With the multi-process table, the page identifies the minimum-capacity process and gives the gap and additional machines, but still does not model transfer batches, changeovers, rework or actual cycle time.
